name: Travel Admin Organizer (lean)
description: Catches booking confirmations as they land in Gmail and keeps one chronological itinerary, buffered calendar events and a reimbursement-ready expense sheet current per trip.
author: veer arora

nextAction.name: home

input.prompt:
Extract the travel booking from this email.

A reschedule or cancellation notice IS a booking event: use kind = change or cancellation.
Use kind = not_a_booking ONLY for marketing, offers or travel insurance policies.

Return only what the email states; never invent a value.
Use the TOTAL amount paid including fees.
If a revised time is given, use the revised one.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: new = first confirmation; change = reschedule of an existing booking; cancellation = booking cancelled; not_a_booking = insurance, marketing or policy notice

fields.name: type
fields.description: flight, train, hotel, cab, bus or other

fields.name: vendor
fields.description: Airline, railway, hotel or cab company

fields.name: confirmation
fields.description: PNR, booking reference or ride ID; empty if none

fields.name: start
fields.description: Departure or check-in, ISO 8601 with +05:30 for Indian local times

fields.name: end
fields.description: Arrival or check-out, ISO 8601; arrivals can fall on the next day

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Total paid including fees, not the base fare

fields.name: category
fields.description: Airfare, Rail, Accommodation, Local transport or Other

fields.name: description
fields.description: Short label, e.g. train number and name

input.title: Travel expenses (created by your travel agent)

nextAction.displayName: Which city do you travel from?
